qrcode.js
=========

QR Code Generator for JavaScript
Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase — http://www.d-project.com/
Licensed under the MIT licence: http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php

"QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.

Vendored verbatim from qrcode-generator@1.4.4, unmodified.

Why vendored rather than loaded from a CDN
------------------------------------------
Same reason as the fonts: a script fetched from someone else's server at page
load reports every teacher's IP to that server, and hands them the ability to
change what runs inside this app. It is served from here instead.

Why vendored rather than written by hand
----------------------------------------
QR encoding is Reed-Solomon error correction, bit interleaving and mask
selection. A subtle bug produces a code that simply will not scan, which is
exactly the failure a teacher discovers in front of thirty children. This is
the reference implementation and it is short enough to read.
